records.text: Owens said Donald Trump appointed John C. Phelan as secretary of the Navy despite Phelan having no military experience and a career background in banking.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Trump appointed a guy with literally zero military experience into that position, crucial position. ... So he appoints this guy John C. Phelan and his whole background is in banking.

verification.notes: The Senate record confirms John C. Phelan's 2025 confirmation as secretary of the Navy. Official Navy biography and military reporting describe his investment-management career and lack of prior military service. These sources support the appointment, no-military-experience, and finance-background components.

records.text: Owens said John C. Phelan hosted a private Aspen fundraiser that raised substantial money for Trump's second-term campaign and included billionaire Steve Wynn.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: he helped Trump raise a ton of money ahead of his second term by hosting this private fundraiser for Trump in Aspen, which featured billionaire guests like Steve Wynn in attendance, and they all sort of cut Trump these big checks.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting confirms John and Amy Phelan hosted a private August 2024 Trump 47 fundraiser at their Aspen home, couples were asked to contribute $25,000 to $500,000, and Steve Wynn was among the guests. That establishes a substantial high-dollar fundraiser and the named attendee.

records.text: Owens cited released passenger manifests as indicating that John C. Phelan flew twice on Jeffrey Epstein's plane in 2006, including a London-to-New York flight with Epstein and Jean-Luc Brunel.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: passenger manifests that were released as part of the Epstein files indicate that Phelan flew twice on the plane of Jeffrey Epstein several months before Epstein's first arrest on sex charges. ... The manifest for the second flight from London to New York on March 3, 2006 indicates that Phelan flew with 12 other passengers, including Epstein, modeling agent and Epstein associate Jean-Luc Brunel.

verification.notes: Released passenger manifests and independent current reporting identify John Phelan on two transatlantic Epstein-plane flights in 2006. One manifest covers a London-to-New York flight and lists Epstein and a misspelled rendering of Jean-Luc Brunel. This verifies the limited manifest claim; presence on a flight does not by itself imply criminal conduct.
